outcome: substantial postpartum weight retention (>= 5 kg) at 1 year postpartum
cohort: The study participants were 747 mothers participating in the KUNO-Kids birth cohort study.
finding: Substantial postpartum weight retention at 1 year was negatively associated with intermediate educational status compared to low educational status, and positively associated with postpartum weight retention at 6 months.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with substantial postpartum weight retention at 1 year.
